title: The rapid adoption of AI coding tools has let workers generate massive volumes of code, leaving companies scrambling to review and secure the AI-generated code (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: The rapid adoption of AI coding tools has let workers generate massive volumes of code, leaving companies scrambling to review and secure the AI-generated code — When a financial services company recently began using Cursor, an artificial intelligence technology that writes computer code, the difference that it made was immediate.
